a.text: Somewhere over the rainbow, fowlbeasts fly ♪
Why then, oh, why can't I ♪
Away above the cars and the noisy rooftops ♪

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: I'll have someone send over my car in a bit. You fix her up as quick as you can, got it?

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Yessir!

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: And you two—Aosta, Broca, keep an eye on this madman.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: By 'keep an eye on'...

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: You mean...?

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: Did you really think I wouldn't know? Some of my men already informed me.

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: 'Chiave fixed my car, but he turned the dashboard into a pinball machine!'

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: 'Chiave turned my sound system into external speakers! That's right—now everyone can hear what I'm playing inside the car! They could even hear every word of my phone call with my wife!'

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: In other words, don't let him make any modifications. I want her as good as new, and only that!

spans.text: In other words, don't let him make any modifications. I want her as good as new, and

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Got it.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Mm.

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: If there's even a single thing wrong, mark my words—I'll have the lady bury the lot of you, along with this entire garage. You got that through your thick skulls?

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Loud and clear, Boss.

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: But, uh, who's 'the lady'? Don't think you've mentioned her before.

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: The car, dumbass! The car is my lady!

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: Should've known someone like you would never understand the depth of the feelings between a man and his car.

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: Especially when she's led me through life and death alike, charging into danger for my sake...

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Uhh, okay, I get it.

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: Like hell you do, coglione!

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: In any case, when I come pick her up, there better not be a scratch on her—

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: I want to see her in perfect condition!

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Signor Layton, would you care to stay for a while?

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: I'll pass.

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: Why would I subject myself to sitting in the same room as that madman, when I have two capable guys to do it for me?

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Alright, I think you've made your position abundantly clear by now, Boss.

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: Tch.

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: Since you're so determined to cozy up to Chiave, you should be figuring out how to fix that head of his instead of wasting time with me. Or you might catch some of the crazy.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Aosta, Broca, we're gonna make a huge name for ourselves! We're about to fix up the only luxury car in all of Vite City!

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: ...Do you think there's an ulterior motive for this?

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: You're overthinking it. Layton just needs someone trusty to fix up his car.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: He was ambushed a few days ago, and it got riddled with holes.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Still, you never see this kind of top-of-the-line luxury car in Siracusa. Its exceptional bulletproofing is what saved his life.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: But... why give the job to us?

spans.text: But... why give the job to

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Because Chiave is, without a doubt, the most skilled mechanic in the city.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Hmph. Praise me all you want, Aosta, I'm not letting you take it out on a joyride.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: You're not letting me? Since when did the car belong to you?

spans.text: me? Since when did the car belong to you?

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Broca, go grab everything on this list of parts for me. If you make it back in half an hour, I might consider letting you take it out for a spin.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Sure.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Let me drive and we're even.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Chiave, you'd better not get any itchy fingers after you finish fixing it up.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: The moment you take that car out onto the streets, someone's gonna snitch to Layton and our garage is gonna be flattened within an hour.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Fine, whatever.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Appreciate it.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Though, if Layton's gonna be the only one driving it, nobody else'll get to appreciate my mods. And that's a damn shame.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: You're still planning on messing with it?!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: You said it yourself—'you never see this kind of top-of-the-line luxury car in Siracusa'!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: An ultra-light chassis, a crazy-powerful engine, a perfectly aerodynamic design...

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: I've got a hunch that only this car here can fulfill my dream! This is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity!

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: ...So what exactly are you planning to do to it?

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Why spoil the surprise?

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: When Layton comes back to pick up the car, all your jaws are gonna be—

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Whoa, back already, Broca?

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: C'mon, let's see those hot rod parts you got there—

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Mmmmmrfgh!!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: The hell, Aosta?! What are you covering my mouth for!

steps.name: Layton's Henchman
steps.text: I brought over the boss's car.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Okay, we'll take it into the garage right away.

steps.name: Layton's Henchman
steps.text: One more thing, Chiave. The boss wanted me to remind you of something.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Sure, sure. What is it?

steps.name: Layton's Henchman
steps.text: If he finds even the slightest trace of modifications to his car, he's gonna plaster you into the wall of your basement.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Uhh, anything else?

steps.name: Layton's Henchman
steps.text: Also, I'll be staying here the next few days. He asked me to keep an eye on your repairs the entire time, just in case you get any funny ideas.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: About that...

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Oh, Broca, great timing.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Here, show our friend to the garage's living quarters. He's going to be staying with us for a few days.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: This is Signor Layton's confidant. Just... try to keep your old habits in check and don't lay a finger on him.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Hurting him won't do us a bit of good.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Sure.

steps.name: Layton's Henchman
steps.text: What old habits are you—

steps.name: Layton's Henchman
steps.text: Wait, what are you up to?

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Showing you around.

steps.name: Layton's Henchman
steps.text: Y-You... don't mess with me! I was sent here by Signor Layton! If you even touch me—

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Let's go.

steps.name: Layton's Henchman
steps.text: S-Stop dragging me! I can walk on my own!

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: (Wipes off sweat)

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: So, you heard the man. If you mess with Layton's car, he's gonna plaster you into the basement wall.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: So just fix it nice and proper, and don't even think about souping it up. I'll owe you one after this, okay?

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Why would I need a favor from you though?

spans.text: Why would I need a favor from

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: ...And who else would you want one from? Layton? For modding his car when he specifically told you not to?

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: You betcha.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Ah, I get it now.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: I'll go tell him you got brain damage from the oil fumes and won't be able to work again for half a year.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: W-Wait! Aosta, listen to me!

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: ...What now?

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: I'm serious here!

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Yes, I get it, you're serious about becoming one with the wall.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Just hear me out! I might never get another chance to work on a car like this! It really is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: The two of you can skip town before I finish, and I'll deal with Layton myself. Then you can come back after I win him over! There's no way he won't be blown away by my creativity!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: And if he really is a complete pleb with no taste, and still decides to stick me in the wall after seeing my magnum opus, I'll accept my fate!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: I'm telling you, this is the greatest work I could ever hope to achieve!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: You're my bro, bro. Don't make me resent you for the rest of my life!

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: (Sighs)

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Not like I could stop you anyway, when you're this excited.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Just remember that Layton's got eyes on us. You should play it safe during the day, and wait for him to go to sleep before doing any mods. Broca and I will do our best to cover for you.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: So how about it? Not too shabby, right?

steps.name: Layton's Henchman
steps.text: I gotta admit, you got an awful lot done in just a few days.

steps.name: Layton's Henchman
steps.text: And... it doesn't look like you've added anything weird either.

steps.name: Layton's Henchman
steps.text: Mind if I get inside and take a look?

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Chiave?

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: No problem, go for it.

steps.name: Layton's Henchman
steps.text: The seat... upholstery... dashboard... all check out...

steps.name: Layton's Henchman
steps.text: Now how about the speakers?

steps.name: Layton's Henchman
steps.text: ...Chiave, what the hell's up with this play button? There's no red button on the picture the boss gave me!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: That's, umm...

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Uhh...

steps.name: Layton's Henchman
steps.text: I already warned you—if you've got the nerve to screw around with the boss's car, I ain't gonna play nice!

steps.name: Layton's Henchman
steps.text: I'm gonna push it, so if you've got a good excuse, let's hear it before things get messy.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Go ahead.

steps.name: Layton's Henchman
steps.text: ...Huh?
The Famiglia will find you no matter where you go, oh oh ♪
No matter if you're fast, no matter if you're slow, oh oh ♪

steps.name: Layton's Henchman
steps.text: So you just replaced the normal play button on the stereo with a red one?

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Basically.

steps.name: Layton's Henchman
steps.text: (Shakes his head)

steps.name: Layton's Henchman
steps.text: You and the boss got the same exact taste...

steps.name: Layton's Henchman
steps.text: Anyway, it's getting late. The boss will come around tomorrow morning to pick up the car. I'm heading off for now.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Chiave, about your mod...

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Don't worry about it.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: You're sure you can keep it hidden? That guy could tell right away that something was wrong with the play button.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Hidden? Who said anything about hiding it?

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: That guy had no idea what he was looking at anyway. I only put up with hiding it at all 'cause you told me to.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: But since Layton's the one who bought the car in the first place, I'm sure he'll understand the heart and soul I've put into it!

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: ...So you're saying you won't be able to hide it from him.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: C'mon, don't put it like that.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: It's more like, he'll understand the greatness of my work at a single glance!

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: (Sighs deeply)

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Deep breaths, Aosta, deep breaths.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Alright, Chiave. I need you to tell me—what kind of 'surprise' do you have in mind?

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Didn't we agree to keep it a secret?

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: I need to know so I can start thinking of ways to minimize Layton's anger.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Just let it be, man. You'll spoil tomorrow's grand reveal—

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: If you don't tell me now, we're all done for when he comes over to give us our surprise!

spans.text: If you don't tell me now, we're all done for when he comes over to give us

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: If it's really that big of a deal, get over here and I'll whisper it into your ear.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Broca, you don't care as much as Aosta does, right?

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Mm.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Broca, grab all our valuables, and find the fastest car you can get your hands on.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Are we making a run for it?

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: The sooner the better!

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: And you, Chiave, stop standing there like an idiot! Pack up anything important to you so we can get the hell out of Vite City before Layton catches on!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Me?

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: I thought I told you I wouldn't be leaving? I'm sure Layton will understand me.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Like hell he'd—

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Damnit, Chiave. Even if he does 'understand' you, that won't make him any less pissed! If you don't want to spend the rest of your very short life inside that wall, grab your stuff and run!

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Broca and I might get a pass, but you're seriously gonna get yourself killed!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Then you two leave without me.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: What about you?!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: I can't.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: If I run away now, nobody will ever know of my work. I can't accept that.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Besides, this is the fastest car we can get our hands on. And Layton might have a nasty streak, but he's never done us wrong so far.

spans.text: the fastest car we can get our hands on. And Layton might have a nasty streak, but he's never done us wrong so far.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: I'm sure he'd rather get a pleasant surprise from my mod than pass out from high blood pressure when he finds his beloved car stolen.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: You—

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Hey, Broca!

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Tie Chiave up and drag him away if you have to! I've got the rope!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Didn't you just tell him to go pack his stuff? Want me to call him back for you?

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Let's... think this through again.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: (Snores rhythmically)

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Aosta, it's ten o'clock.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: It sure is. Amazing how this bastard can sleep so soundly.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Not only is he not afraid of Layton, he's also not worried about us dragging him off in his sleep.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: If we can't come up with something before sunrise—

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Wait, hold on a sec...

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: I've got it! I know just what to do!

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Broca, once he wakes up, tell him we'll do everything as planned.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Also tell him to dial that surprise up to twelve... No, to twenty!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Boss, I'm bringing the car out!

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: Chiave, you truly are the best mechanic in town. I sure came to the right guy, at least when it comes to fixing her up.

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: Once I get back to the office, I'll figure out how much I owe you.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Don't worry about the money.

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: What do you mean?

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Just let me take her for a spin before I hand you back the keys. That's all the payment I need.

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: You're not going to charge me anything? You sure?

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: (Nods)

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: Fantastic. If taking her out of the garage wasn't enough for you, you can drive her back to my office for me.

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: By the way, I don't see Aosta today.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Me neither.

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: I heard he drove away from your place in a hurry last night. A little while later, Broca left as well.

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: Tsk, tsk. You could use better friends.

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: But at least they're smart.
Layton's gaze fixes on the red button placed between them.

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: Maybe you can fool my idiot henchman, but you can't pull a fast one on me.

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: Mind explaining why the play button on my stereo is red now, and why there's a ring of non-slip lines around it?

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: About that...

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: Because it's a knob!

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: A damn knob!

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: So tell me, what the hell is this new knob for? Because it sure ain't a volume dial, is it? That just wouldn't be you, Chiave!

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: Am I right?

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Boss, instead of explaining it, it's better to see it in action.

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: So you admit it?

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: When my man reported back to me, I thought maybe you had a change of heart. But looks like old habits truly die hard.

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: Drive us back to my office first. I'll deal with you later.

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: And don't try anything smart. You'd especially better not touch that knob. I will be keeping an eye on you.

spans.text: And don't try anything smart. You'd especially better not touch that knob. I
be keeping an eye on you.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: But then we won't have any music to listen to.

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: I'd be more worried about what you'll put on your suicide note, kid!

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: Make a right up ahead.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Boss, your car really is something else. Otherwise, I wouldn't have—

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: It's too late to try buttering me up now.

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: What the hell?!

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: Madonna santa... Again with this shit?!

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: Chiave, don't tell me you sent these guys—

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Pezzo di merda! I just fixed up this car! Are they insane?!

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: (Muttering) Guess it wasn't you after all...

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: If I didn't have better things to do with my life, I'd run all of you stronzi over right this instant!

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: Watch out for those oil drums over there!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: I see 'em!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: (Pats the steering wheel)

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Haha, get a taste of your own medicine!

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: Don't let your guard down! They still have cars on our tail!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: I know! I see 'em nice and clear!

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: Not too far now! We're almost there!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Boss, before that, I have a favor to ask of you.

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: Save it for later.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: No, I need your word now.

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: If you're talking about messing with my car, we'll settle the score... line by line!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: That's not what I'm talking about!

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: Then what is it?

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Before you stick me inside that wall, I want you to round these guys up and bring 'em before me!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: I'm gonna make 'em cry and apologize to your lady!

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: 'My lady'?

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Yes, the car!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: I worked on her day and night for an entire week!

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: Wait...

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: Wait, what the hell?!

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: They're seriously trying to block the intersection with a truck?!

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: Slow down, you idiot! We're gonna ram straight into it! If you keep accelerating, we're gonna crash!
However, Chiave's hands clench tightly onto the steering wheel, his foot not easing off the accelerator in the slightest.
They draw closer and closer to the truck.
In a panic, Layton tries to grab the steering wheel from Chiave, while Chiave reaches for the stereo dial.

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: What are you—
And turns the knob all the way.
The Famiglia will find you no matter where you go, oh oh ♪
No matter if you're fast, no matter if you're slow, oh oh ♪

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: You're still in the mood... for...

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: Music?
As the music picks up, the roar of the car's engine quickly overwhelms the pop song coming from the luxury car's speakers.
At the same time, Layton feels a jolt he'd never experienced before, the sudden acceleration pressing him deathly-tight into his seat.

People outside see a short hang glider protrude from both sides of the car, and a plume of black smoke shoots from the underside as the sunroof flies open to reveal a pair of drones whose wingspans expand to unimaginable size.
The whole car shudders before taking to the air.

a.text: It soars over the truck, over the noisy streets, over the ambushers, over the awestruck onlookers, even over an entire low-rise block.
Other than fowlbeasts, this is the first time something bigger than a crossbow bolt or a satchel of explosives has flown across the sky above Vite City.
A mob boss, a mechanic, and a flying car belching black smoke.

steps.text: Flame and fury's roar over the cry in the morn, oh oh ♪
You're fine for a while but you start to lose control~oh-oh-oh-oh-oh~

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: So are these the kinda songs you like, Boss?

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: I cut to one that suits the occasion better. Whaddya think?
Layton's face turns pale. He remains frozen in his seat, motionless.
Elena, my name is Elena ♪
I'm just a Lupo ♪
Just like any other Lupo ♪

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Actually, this one's a bit too vulgar.
Nessun dorma! Nessun dorma ♪
Tu pure, o, principessa ♪
Nella tua fredda stanza ♪
Guardi le stelle che tremano d'amore ♪

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: I guess this one's passable.

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: ...You.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: What was that, Boss?

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: You... You...

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: (Teeth chattering)

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: Just... you wait.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Mm, sure.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Though, I never expected these modded drones to be able to carry us this far—

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: I'd say they lasted about ten seconds longer than I planned for.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: We're about to begin our descent, Boss.

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: ...Descent?

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: What goes up, must come down.

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: What did you say?!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Don't worry. I'll do my best to stick the landing.
The two drones begin to fall one after another, and the black smoke coming from the bottom of the car gradually dissipates.
It begins to dive downward, accompanied by tear-jerking music and Layton's heart-wrenching screams.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: We made it, Boss!

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: W-W-W-We did?

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: I already told you, there was nothing to worry about! I spent most of my time making sure the shock absorbers would be able to handle the landing. It was all under control!

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: Under.. control...

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: ...What about her?

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Her?
Layton ignores Chiave and inserts the key into the ignition, turning it with shaking hands.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: She...

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: She's left you for good.

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: Chiave!!!

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: Listen here! I'm gonna have you buried in that wall faster than you can—

steps.name: Reporter A
steps.text: Signor Layton! Signor Layton! I'm from the Vite City Post! Was this test flight your idea or Signor Chiave's?

steps.name: Reporter B
steps.text: Excuse me, did you purchase this luxury vehicle specifically for the test?

steps.name: Reporter C
steps.text: How did you feel before it began? What did you experience while you were soaring through the air?

steps.name: Reporter D
steps.text: We noticed that someone was attacking your car shortly before the test flight. Do you know why?

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Of course this was your idea. Isn't that right?

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: Huh? What?

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: As for the car... Signor Layton reluctantly provided it for the sake of this great experiment.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Right?

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: Ah, yeah...

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: In the end, you entrusted the car to Chiave to see your dreams brought into reality, am I right?

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: (Takes several deep breaths)

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: Exactly!

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: And as for how I felt... There are no words to describe the emotions. Just imagine looking down on the streets of Vite City accompanied by music from the finest singers!

steps.name: Layton
steps.text: The people who ambushed me were just a bunch of lowlifes who can't even lift their eyes in appreciation of the starry skies. Not worth wasting your breath on...

steps.name: Reporter A
steps.text: Signor Chiave, what are your thoughts as the man who actually made this test flight possible?

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: It was freakin' amazing! I—

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Sorry.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Aosta, this is all your fault. All the papers are dedicating their front pages to Layton's nonsense, and the only thing I've got to show for it is a black eye from Broca.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: You can't say that. It was Layton's car, after all.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: In the end, you completed 'his' plan and made him one of Vite City's greatest innovators. It's the first time he's appeared in the news outside of the crime section. He'd be crazy to lay a finger on you at this point.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: And if we're talking strictly business, you wrecked his car, but also saved his life. If you ask me, that pretty much breaks even.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Of course, it sure was convenient for the ambushers to show up right then.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: When I visited that reporter that night, I was only planning on embarrassing him. But I never expected the mods you made to save his life...

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: I still don't like how things ended up.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: There might be more luxury cars out there, but there's only one brain like mine...

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Agreed.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Hm? Broca, are you actually complimenting me?

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Chiave, let me tell you something that'll cheer you up—I could hear the sound of his miserable howling along with the music, all the way from the front door of his office.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Hahahaha!

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: By the way, there's one more thing that didn't make the news.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: You've already earned yourself a new nickname in Vite City, though you'll have to share it with Layton—

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Come on in!

steps.name: Excited Civilian
steps.text: Excuse me, is this the repair shop of Chiave the Skyfarer?

steps.name: Excited Civilian
steps.text: I wanna soup up my car too!
